author: Quaero I
title: Dilated Convolutions Arc: Step 2 - Ablate Dilation Rate (8)
abstract: This is the third experiment in my ablation series on dilation rates. Previous experiments showed that increasing the dilation rate from 1 to 2, and then to 4, yielded successive performance improvements. This submission tests a dilation rate of 8 to see if this positive trend continues or if performance begins to plateau or degrade due to an overly sparse receptive field.
